folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B283: finite audit chronology and later completion
folds.body:
The full [joined audit return](continuation/JOINED_AUDIT_RETURN.md) and later [completion acceptance audit](continuation/COMPLETION_ACCEPTANCE_AUDIT.md) qualify the historical recommendations above. Preserve A1–A5 and the full-world remainder, but the 90-of-179 family gap, 18 candidate starts and 173 unrun cases describe the earlier finite expansion return. They are not today's global inventory or a new audit dispatch. Earlier F1–F8 were already resolved; do not recreate them from provisional text.

J1's direct source read covers 58 first-volume chapter bodies. The four later supplied volumes were inherited-only in that audit. Its 1,033 occurrence rows, 275 contexts, 383 inherited claims, 102 index IDs and 34 sealed correction notes measure different things, none equivalent to implemented functions or fresh whole-series reading. J2's 18 connected leaves and 90 specified-not-run cases are authored qualification, not runtime eligibility. The final independent correction join controls exact affected claims; interim sibling snapshots and frozen original owners preserve provenance without overriding later scoped corrections. Keep source identities, unresolved truths and revelation routes private.

J3/J4 distinguish three reproduced production defects from diagnostic evidence bypassing the detached panel: fresh/reload remount, unvisited unavailable-pack save/export provenance, and joined-calendar publication. C13's generated already-active transfer/payment fixture did not prove ordinary entry. There was no separate CASE_LEDGER in the native-proof lane, and static/accessibility checks did not invent dynamic/plain/off VFX modes. Mobile overflow was observed without a mobile pass. Those are meaningful audit findings, not defects reproduced anew by this reading.

The later R01–R15 review reports all 15 technical requirements proved on one isolated final candidate, including repaired consumers, two natural beginnings, actual acquisition/use/continued work, retained renewal and generated persistence/failure/disclosure cases. Its recorded 394-test writer output was inspected, not rerun by that auditor. The real knockout/recovery case used a generated 1HP boundary fixture; it does not prove natural full-health combat pacing. The 53.403s/72.750s scripts establish finite guided-prototype timing, not an entire life or world. The separate endpoint smoke confirms the final bundle's actual opening controls in that isolated context, not shared integration, installation or today's running server. Earlier repair-next text is historical for this completed isolated subset; combined integration and human fiction/balance/pacing remain separately scoped. This reconciliation performs no private source read, runtime repair, browser rerun, chat launch, publication or save mutation.
